text: dsh-qqbot-panel 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的 QQ Bot 设置面板，在设置页注册 QQ Bot 页面，并通过主机端 API 读取和写入 QQ Bot profile 的 cordis.patch.yml。面板可管理 AppID、AppSecret、私聊与群聊访问模式及允许名单、requireMention 和工作目录，也能列出已有会话的工作区，并通过 QQ 扫码流程绑定凭据。它适合希望从网页管理 QQ Bot profile 的 DSH 用户；需要安装官方 QQ Bot 配套插件。

dsh-qqbot-panel adds a QQ Bot page to DSH web settings and edits the QQ Bot profile’s cordis.patch.yml. Manage AppID and AppSecret, chat access modes and allowlists, requireMention, and working directory. It lists workspaces and supports QQ QR binding. Requires the official QQ Bot plugin.
想从 DSH 网页设置页面管理 QQ Bot 的配置。
能不能在网页里扫码绑定 QQ 机器人并保存凭据？
I want to choose the workspace where my QQ Bot sessions are stored.
dsh-qqbot-panel 的功能「QQ Bot 配置面板」：在 DSH Web 设置页编辑 AppID、AppSecret、私聊和群聊访问模式及名单、requireMention 与工作目录，并保存到配置文件。
dsh-qqbot-panel 的功能「扫码绑定」：在设置面板启动 QQ 扫码连接并显示二维码；绑定成功后将返回的 AppID 和 AppSecret 写入 QQ Bot 配置。

dsh-qqbot-panel README · dsh-qqbot-panel：> **English** | [**中文**](README.zh.md)

A visual settings panel for the official [@tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot](https://github.com/tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot) plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh). The official QQ bot plugin is a pure CLI plugin with no Web UI; this companion plugin adds a **Settings → QQ Bot** page so you can configure everything — and even bind your bot by scanning a QR code — right from the web GUI.

dsh-qqbot-panel README · Features：- **Settings panel** — web GUI: Settings → QQ Bot. Manage `appId` / `appSecret`, private-chat (c2c) & group access modes (`open` / `allowlist` / `disabled`) and their allowlists, `requireMention`, and the agent working directory.
- **Scan-to-bind** — one click generates a QR code inside the panel; scan it with the QQ app and the returned `appId` / `appSecret` are written back automatically (no browser connect page, no Apple-ID login).
- **Workspace picker** — choose which workspace the QQ bot's agent sessions live in (`cwd`); the panel lists every workspace that already has sessions and its session count.
- Reads/writes the `im-qqbot` row in the qqbot profile's `cordis.patch.yml` via a loopback-only `/api/dsh-qqbot-panel` route family.
- `appSecret` is only ever returned masked and is never overwritten by an empty value.

dsh-qqbot-panel README · Companion / dependency：This is a **companion panel** for the [official QQ bot plugin](https://github.com/tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot) (`@tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot`). That plugin must be installed and bound to a QQ bot for this panel to be useful — the panel edits the same `cordis.patch.yml` the QQ bot profile loads.

Runtime `dependencies` (installed automatically): `@tencent-connect/qqbot-connector`, `qrcode`, `js-yaml`.

text:
dsh-qqbot-panel README · Configuration：Everything is managed from the panel: Settings → QQ Bot. There you can set `appId` / `appSecret`, the access modes and allowlists, whether group chats need `@bot` (`requireMention`), and the workspace the QQ bot sessions land in.

The panel persists changes to the qqbot profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (`~/.dsh/profiles/qqbot/cordis.patch.yml`), which the running QQ bot hot-reloads.

dsh-qqbot-panel README · Notes：- The `/api/dsh-qqbot-panel` routes are loopback-only (browser same-origin only).
- The scan-to-bind flow uses the QQ bot connect task; the returned `appId`/`appSecret` are stored with mode `0600` in the qqbot profile config.
- Logo / branding intentionally minimal; the panel uses plain inline styles and no external UI kit.
